description: This file defines vector types and helper functions for PowerVSX vector intrinsics used in CPU vectorized computations within the ATen library of PyTorch. It includes type definitions, casting functions, vectorized math operations, and mask/constant definitions specific to VSX.

methods.name: make_vuint
methods.description: Creates unsigned vector types from signed vector types using reinterpret_cast.

methods.name: vec_float
methods.description: Converts integer vector to float vector using inline assembly.

methods.name: vec_signed
methods.description: Converts float vector to integer vector using inline assembly.

methods.name: vec_neg
methods.description: Negates vectorized float or integer vectors using inline assembly or operator overloading.

methods.name: vec_sldw_aux
methods.description: Helper function for vector shift left with immediate.

methods.name: vec_sldw
methods.description: Macro to call vec_sldw_aux with a specific shift amount.

methods.name: vec_min_nan
methods.description: Vectorized min function that propagates NaN.

methods.name: vec_max_nan
methods.description: Vectorized max function that propagates NaN.

methods.name: VsxShiftRightArith
methods.description: Template function for arithmetic right shift with bounds checking.

methods.name: VsxShiftLeftArith
methods.description: Template function for arithmetic left shift with bounds checking.

methods.name: VsxMask1
methods.description: Creates a boolean mask vector from a 4-bit mask.

methods.name: VsxMask2
methods.description: Creates a boolean mask vector from an 8-bit mask shifted right by 4.

methods.name: VsxDblMask1
methods.description: Creates a 2-element boolean mask vector from a 4-bit mask.

methods.name: VsxDblMask2
methods.description: Creates a 2-element boolean mask vector from an 8-bit mask shifted right by 2.

methods.name: maskForComplex
methods.description: Generates a mask for complex number operations based on input mask.

methods.name: maskForComplexDbl
methods.description: Generates a mask for double-precision complex number operations.

methods.name: blendChoice
methods.description: Determines blending mode based on mask bits.

methods.name: blendChoiceDbl
methods.description: Determines blending mode for double-precision based on mask bits.

methods.name: VsxComplexMask1
methods.description: Creates a complex mask vector from a mask.

methods.name: VsxComplexMask2
methods.description: Creates a complex mask vector from a mask shifted right by 2.

methods.name: VsxComplexDblMask1
methods.description: Creates a double-precision complex mask vector.

methods.name: VsxComplexDblMask2
methods.description: Creates a double-precision complex mask vector shifted right by 2.
